summary: Documents an already deployed RADIUS extension in which a client can query whether a RADIUS server is working, using the Status-Server packet code that RFC 2865 reserved for experimental use. It is informational and not an Internet standard.

eli5.summary: A network gate keeper sometimes wants to know if the person who checks passwords is still at their desk. This describes a simple "are you there?" message for RADIUS servers.

questions: how to check if a radius server is alive
